interface.longDescription: Use the Healthcare Agents plugin as a self-directing front door for healthcare administration work. It routes plain-language problems through workflow-first triage, department or area hints, and focused specialist prompts across revenue cycle, quality, compliance, clinical administration, payer, health IT, population health, pharmacy, operations, strategy, and emergency preparedness.
